messages:
pd-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH severity page fired for service=inference-queue (trigger=inference-queue-depth>5000). Incident ID: PD-32190 :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Incident created: inference-queue-backlog-5167894321

alex ng: Investigating — seeing steady queue depth rise on prefix-worker. Current depth 6.2k, autoscaler target range 1k-2k.

maria r.: I'm seeing provisioner loops in cloud-api: node requests pending > 4m. Could be instance quota or IAM token issue.

samir: Logs from scale-controller:
```
2026-03-12T14:12:01Z ERROR provisioner: node request failed status=403 body="QuotaExceeded"
2026-03-12T14:12:30Z WARN  scaler: desired=120 actual=40 reason="provision_delay"
```

alex ng: 403 QuotaExceeded — that matches. Oncall to cloud infra to confirm. @ops_lead can you check GCP quota and spare zones?

ops_lead: Ack. Checking quota and pending VMs — also seeing sporadic 502s from image service.

jen: Paging checkout to 2nd oncall if not acked in 5 — PD escalation policy set. Any customer reports?

maria r.: Customer monitoring shows 2.1% latency >2s for generation endpoint and 0.4% 5xx. Not high yet but climbing.

samir: Workaround: we can temporarily bypass autoscaler and manually increase node group target, then route new jobs to warmed nodes. Command:
```
kubectl patch --namespace infra gcp-nodepool scale --patch '{"spec":{"replicas":80}}'
```

alex ng: Doing manual scale now. Also enabling prefix-level reject policy to shed best-effort requests: `route: prefix/* weight: 0.2`

oncall-bot: PagerDuty ack by alex ng (primary oncall). Incident status: acknowledged.

ops_lead: GCP team confirms quota request throttled; approving short-term quota bump + manual node spinup.

jen: After manual scale, queue depth dropped from 6.2k -> 1.8k over 3m. Throughput recovered.

maria r.: Confirming: error rate down to 0.12%, latency tail improving. Marking as mitigated but still monitoring.

alex ng: Postmortem actions:
- Request permanent quota increase for production project
- Add fallback to pre-provision spare nodes (warm pool)
- Improve autoscaler backoff and better error handling for 403/Quota errors

samir: Creating followup ticket: INFRA-4321. Will track until quota bump permanent.

jen: Closing PD incident after handoff to SREs for follow-up. Thanks all :thumbsup:

pd-bot: PagerDuty: incident PD-32190 resolved by alex ng
